turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Harbor Federal Credit Union · Monthly check-in · October 20, 2026

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** [PERSON_1] (VP, Member Experience), [PERSON_2] (Marketing Operations Manager), [PERSON_3] (Compliance Manager), [PERSON_4] (CSM, Invoca)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Harbor's September call volume rose 18% over August, driven by card fraud alert texts, and the team absorbed it without new hiring. [PERSON_1] reported that call summaries have meaningfully reduced prep time for her team leads. [PERSON_3] raised one compliance need on QM scorecards, and [PERSON_2] flagged a manual reporting step he wants automated. One how-to on user administration was resolved live on the call.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: September volume up 18% from fraud-alert texts; spike started the first week and held most of the month. No coverage gaps reported.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] asked how scorecard updates are versioned and audited; [PERSON_4] described the change log and said compliance can request edit history for any scorecard. No decision needed today.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] said member services is getting positive feedback from team leads on AI call summaries as a pre-call primer; no metrics yet.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] asked how to add a new user for a summer intern replacement. [PERSON_4] walked him through Settings > Users during the call; he completed the add and the invite went out. No ticket needed.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Confirmed the next QM governance review with [PERSON_3]'s team for mid-November; [PERSON_4] to send calendar hold.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Harbor's renewal is Feb 2027; no action items this month.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] wants a QM scorecard criterion that checks whether agents read the Reg E dispute disclosure on card dispute calls. The standard templates don't have anything close.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] said the call summaries have cut callback prep for her team leads to almost nothing.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] is still exporting the weekly calls dashboard to CSV by hand every Monday; he asked if we can schedule it straight into Google Sheets.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: None identified this month. Volume spike was handled within existing staffing and QM review capacity.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Send calendar hold for mid-November QM governance review, [PERSON_4], by Oct 27.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Share Reg E disclosure signal feasibility with QM product team and follow up with [PERSON_3], [PERSON_4], by Nov 3.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Confirm whether scheduled dashboard delivery to Google Sheets is supported and report back, [PERSON_4], by Oct 30.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Send [PERSON_2] a short recap of the Settings > Users steps for onboarding future hires, [PERSON_4], by Oct 23.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Forward any team lead quotes on summary impact to [PERSON_4] for the account file, [PERSON_1], by Nov 6.
